gloss: a wasted trip; going somewhere in vain

definitions.gloss: a wasted trip; a futile errand; going somewhere in vain
definitions.explanation: The act of going somewhere only to find that the trip was pointless — the person was out, the shop was closed, the item was sold out, etc.

examples.japanese: {店|みせ}が{休|やす}みで{無駄足|むだあし}を{踏|ふ}んだ。
examples.english: The shop was closed and I made the trip for nothing.

examples.japanese: {事前|じぜん}に{電話|でんわ}で{確認|かくにん}しておけば、{無駄足|むだあし}を{踏|ふ}まずに{済|す}んだのに。
examples.english: If I had called ahead to check, I could have avoided the wasted trip.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {無駄|むだ} (waste) and {足|あし} (foot/trip). The set phrase {無駄足|むだあし}を{踏|ふ}む means 'to make a wasted trip.' Often used when expressing frustration after going somewhere only to find it was pointless.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無駄足|むだあし}を{踏|ふ}む (to make a wasted trip)
- {無駄足|むだあし}になる (to turn out to be a wasted trip)
- {無駄足|むだあし}を{踏|ふ}ませる (to send someone on a wild goose chase)
